statement: Between 2026-10-18 and 2026-11-01, Russia launches at least 600 drones and missiles combined against Ukraine in a single overnight attack, as tallied by the Ukrainian Air Force.
resolution: A Ukrainian Air Force tally, repeated by Reuters or AP, gives at least 600 drones and missiles combined for one overnight attack with a report date between 2026-10-18 and 2026-11-01 inclusive.
failure_condition: No single overnight Russian attack of at least 600 drones and missiles combined occurred between 2026-10-18 and 2026-11-01.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
